review.summary: Mercedes lead the championship with 578 points after 17 rounds and have taken 11 wins and 22 podiums. Andrea Kimi Antonelli tops the drivers' standings ahead of George Russell. In Singapore, Antonelli claimed a third-place finish for 15 points while Russell recovered from nineteenth to ninth for two.
review.lastRace: Antonelli finished third from fourth on the grid, scoring 15 points; Russell climbed from nineteenth to ninth for two.

Max Verstappen won from the front row for Red Bull, holding off Charles Leclerc to take a narrow victory over the Ferrari. Andrea Kimi Antonelli completed the podium for Mercedes in third. The classification shows the winner untroubled at the head of the field while several mid-field cars were lapped as gaps opened up.
highlights: Isack Hadjar climbed from twenty-second to tenth for Red Bull, taking one point.
George Russell recovered from nineteenth to ninth for Mercedes, scoring two points.
Charles Leclerc set the fastest lap of the race while finishing second for Ferrari.
Alexander Albon, Franco Colapinto, Gabriel Bortoleto and Lance Stroll all retired without scoring.

review.summary: Marco Bezzecchi won for Aprilia Racing, with Raul Fernandez of SuperFile Trackhouse MotoGP Team second and fellow Aprilia Racing rider Jorge Martin third on the podium. Points extended to fifteenth-placed Alex Rins, while Topraz Razgatlioglu, Jack Miller, Francesco Bagnaia and Fermin Aldeguer did not finish.
highlights: Marco Bezzecchi won for Aprilia Racing on 25 points.
Raul Fernandez of SuperFile Trackhouse MotoGP Team finished second, with fellow Aprilia Racing rider Jorge Martin third.
Topraz Razgatlioglu, Jack Miller, Francesco Bagnaia and Fermin Aldeguer did not finish.

review.summary: Taylor Barnard won the London E-Prix for DS Penske from sixth on the grid, ahead of Mahindra's Nyck De Vries who took second from pole with Edoardo Mortara third from second to complete a podium double. The classification shows a strong climb by Barnard into the lead, while Porsche had a difficult round as Pascal Wehrlein dropped from third to fourteenth and Nico Müller slipped from fourth to twelfth.
highlights: Taylor Barnard won the London E-Prix for DS Penske, climbing from sixth on the grid to finish at the head of the field.
Nyck De Vries finished second from pole with Edoardo Mortara third from second, giving Mahindra a podium double.
Pascal Wehrlein dropped from third on the grid to fourteenth, while Nico Müller slipped from fourth to twelfth for Porsche.
Sébastien Buemi climbed from tenth to fifth for Envision Racing, one of several drivers who gained places on the starting grid.
